description: This file is a shell script containing tests for 'git svn' functionality, including initialization, import, checkout, tree checksumming, and various repository state tests. The script uses functions and commands to verify the behavior of 'git svn' operations and their integration with Subversion repositories.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Sets up the locale environment for UTF-8 testing

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the given command fails

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Runs SVN commands with test wrappers

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message

methods.name: test-tool chmtime
methods.description: Modifies file modification times for testing
